prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of this room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this room, the front view (the establishing view): the camera stands at the centre of the front wall, at eye level, facing the back wall, with a 35mm lens and natural textures. The room layout and furniture placement should exactly match Image 1. The place is completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette, mannequin or reflection of a person anywhere, including behind glass, through doorways and in the distance. Location: Sebastian's apartment, living room. The living room of a small but bright, clean and stylish present-day one-bedroom downtown apartment, with white walls, a pale oak floor and warm modern-minimalist décor. Back wall: on its left half, a large floor-to-ceiling window with sheer linen curtains looking out over the city skyline; by day, sunlight streams in through it from behind, and by night the city lights glow through it. On the right half of the back wall is the white panelled bedroom door, the only bedroom. Left wall: the apartment's front door, a dark-grey panelled door with a brass handle, which is the way in, with wall hooks and a slim oak shoe bench beside it. Right wall: a compact open kitchenette with white flat-front cabinets, a pale stone counter and two oak stools tucked under the counter's overhang. Front wall (behind the camera): low oak bookshelves. A charcoal-grey linen three-seat couch stands in the middle of the room, slightly left of centre, its back to the camera, facing the back wall's window, with a brass arc floor lamp at its left end and a low round oak coffee table in front of it. A small round light-oak dining table with two upholstered chairs stands in the right half of the room, between the couch and the kitchenette, nearer the bedroom door. A glass globe pendant lamp hangs over the dining table. At night the warm floor lamp from the left and the pendant over the table are the light sources; by day the window on the back wall gives soft, bright light. Show only this place as described: the doors, windows and openings it names lead nowhere new, with no other exit, courtyard, corridor or outdoor view added. Show it at night, lit by its practical lights: only the sources the description names, from their direction; only lamps the description names may glow warm.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
